Proves AR-6's `inRange` operator on an `int64` field with both boundaries exclusive — the opposite combination from case 039 on the same field/value pair, isolating the inclusivity-flag effect on the compiled comparison operators (`>`/`<` here vs. `>=`/`<=` there) from any field-type variation. Since AG Grid's native `inRange` wire shape carries no inclusivity flags at all, 039 and this case would otherwise share a byte-identical `agGridRequest.json`/`schema.json` with nothing distinguishing them — this fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point to inject a `rangeComparisonNode` with explicit `fromInclusive: false, toInclusive: false`, making the two cases non-contradictory (see the category README).
